scripts.preview: npm run check-deps && concurrently "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && echo '\n✅ Setup complete! Run "npm run preview" to start the development servers.'
scripts.check-deps: node -e "console.log('🔍 Checking dependencies...')" && [ -d "node_modules" ] && [ -d "frontend/node_modules" ] && echo '✅ Dependencies installed' || (echo '❌ Dependencies missing. Run: npm run setup' && exit 1)
scripts.status: echo '🔍 Checking Kara development environment...' && npm run check-deps && echo '✅ Ready to preview! Run: npm run preview'
